integration_notes: Add pub mod blast_hsp_evaluate; no shared files edited.

Ambiguity APIs consume full uncompressed query/subject buffers and absolute HSP coordinates; query high mask nibble is removed exactly where the source does so. Gapped qlen/slen exclude sentinels and must describe complete logical sequences.

Call blast_hsp_list_get_evalues with mutable ScoreBlk after releasing immutable score/matrix scratch borrows; scaling_factor normally 1.0. Existing blast_hits module already owns raw-score/Evalue reaping, gap statistics, odd-score adjustment and bit scores, so these are reused rather than duplicated.
Default path rejects out-of-frame identities. Sum-statistics linking, subject-best-hit/culling/mapping/PHI-specific filters and translated-coordinate output formatting remain outside this closure.

Whole-list statistical check artifacts: /tmp/btyper-hsp-evalue-oracle.c, /tmp/btyper-hsp-evalue-reference.txt, /tmp/btyper-hsp-evalue-check.rs. All 42 focused original-C cases passed in debug and optimized Rust builds.
